# Mohit Dhawan

Founding ML engineer at Providio. Triathlete. Artist. Builds machine learning systems that scale, across agentic AI, NLP, and classical ML and statistics.

Contact: mohit.dhawan2510@gmail.com
Career history: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohit-dhawan98/
GitHub: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98
Writing: https://themlnerd.substack.com and https://medium.com/@mohit.dhawan2510
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/releasenotes.md/

## Fields

- Agentic AI: Agents that plan, use tools and finish multi-step work, with a check that says whether the job was done.
- NLP: Text turned into structure a system can act on: products sorted, documents parsed, notes found again by idea.
- Classical ML and statistics: Matching, pricing, forecasting and experiments. The gain is often in the objective, not in a bigger model.

## Projects

- Providio OS (Agentic AI; done at Providio): Turns the signals an airline's commercial teams receive each day into decisions a person can approve. Page: projects/providio-os.html Link: https://providio.ai/blogs/intro-to-providio-os
- REET (Agentic AI; open source): Research on shrinking an AI agent's context by keeping the facts instead of trimming the words. Paused; small experiments, honestly reported. Status: research prototype, paused. Page: projects/reet.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/reet
- sre-incident-env (Agentic AI; open source): A test of whether an AI agent can fix a simulated production outage, where a wrong fix makes things worse. Page: projects/sre-incident-env.html
- EcommerceClassifier (NLP; done at CommerceIQ): Reads a product's photo and its title and files it into one of 434 grocery and household categories. Page: projects/ecommerce-classifier.html Link: https://huggingface.co/Maverick98/EcommerceClassifier
- Recall (NLP; open source): A private place to save what you read and find it again by idea, not only by keyword. Page: projects/recall.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/Recall
- MindScroll (NLP; open source): Turns a book into a chapter-by-chapter course of flashcards, quizzes and summaries. Status: offline, being rebuilt for the phone. Page: projects/mindscroll.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/MindScroll
- From best match to mutual match (Classical ML and statistics; independent): A matching system that introduces two people only when each is near the top of the other's list. Built as an ML engineer working independently for an AI matchmaking app; the article reports mutual acceptance going from 22% to 68%. Page: work/mutual-match.html
- Dating Environment (Classical ML and statistics; open source): A simulated dating world where you write a matching rule and see how many couples it finds. It approximates the article's method. Page: projects/dating-env.html
- photo-to-paint (Art and tools; open source): Turns a photo into a paint-by-numbers kit you can print and paint, from the assessment to the painting guide. Page: projects/photo-to-paint.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/photo-to-paint
- anima (Art and tools; open source): A few painted views of a character become a head you can turn and give expressions, drawn as a five-grey pixel-art sprite sheet. Status: research prototype. Page: projects/anima.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/anima
- resolve-free-mcp (Art and tools; open source): Lets an AI assistant edit video in the free edition of DaVinci Resolve. Page: projects/resolve-free-mcp.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/resolve-free-mcp
- adalyst-mcp (Art and tools; open source): Lets an AI assistant look up a brand's live ads on Facebook and Instagram and describe what they are doing. Page: projects/adalyst-mcp.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/adalyst-mcp
- unscroll (Art and tools; open source): A tiny Android app that notices when you open YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels and sends you back to the home screen. Page: projects/unscroll.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/unscroll
- PortfolioAnalyzer (Art and tools; open source): Keeps the facts about your investments with a source and a date on each, so an assistant can cite them instead of guessing. Page: projects/portfolio-analyzer.html Link: https://github.com/Mohit-Dhawan98/PortfolioAnalyzer
